description: Free, no API key. The store's own search autocomplete for a seed term and for the seed followed by each letter, in one storefront. These are searches people type there, in the store's order; there is no search-volume figure. A difficulty heuristic is attached only where one was already computed.

country.description: Two-letter storefront code (e.g. us, gb, de). Defaults to us.

platform.description: Store to read. Defaults to ios.

seed.description: A word or short phrase to expand (2 to 50 characters).

name: keyword_suggestions
